name: Non-Redundant Cryo-EM Test Dataset (2026 release targets)
description: Non-Redundant Cryo-EM Test Dataset (2026 release targets) This dataset consists of a curated collection of 12 non-redundant structural targets released in 2026, specifically assembled to benchmark 3D structure prediction, alignment, and macromolecular modeling tools. Reproduction & Executable Notebook:The complete benchmarking workflow, pipeline setup, statistical tables, and performance evaluations are documented and executable via the companion GitHub Jupyter notebook: https://github.com/adelekeadeniyan/cryo-em-benchmarking-2026/blob/main/docs/Cryo-EM%20Density%20Map%20Benchmark.ipynb.
